name: hcportal_getKennelRequests
description: The kennel request review queue (E12.F1.S5/S10): requests in EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport with one RequestStatus, newest first (open statuses 0/1 up to 1000 rows, closed statuses the newest 200), with location ids resolved to names, the reviewer's hash name, the approved kennel's slug, and two warnings: ExistingHasherId/ExistingHashName (a live account already holding the requester's email, which approval makes the admin) and SimilarKennels (open requests only: up to five live kennels matching short name, name or website, same country first). A second rowset counts requests per status for the filter chips. WRITES before reading (2026-10-11): every open request (status 0/1) whose KennelId points at a live kennel is closed as approved (RequestStatus 2, removed 1, ConfirmCode NULL, ReviewedAt now, ReviewNote appended). Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with no context identifier; gate: a live HC.PlatformAdmin row with CanEditKennel = 1. EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport has no file in db/schema/tables; types for later columns come from db/hc6/portal/archive/migration_kennel_request_review_columns.sql, db/hc6/public-web/archive/migration_kennel_request_*.sql and db/hc6/portal/archive/2026-10-10_kennel_from_website_columns.sql; the original HC3 columns have no definition in the repo and are typed loosely.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Portal token; standard param string (device secret).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: 0 awaiting email · 1 new · 2 approved · 3 rejected · 4 spam · 5 duplicate. Default 1.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned alone on auth failure or 'Not authorised: Platform Admin with CanEditKennel required'. Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown (raw error to the API).

rowsets.name: Requests
rowsets.description: On success: one row per request with RequestStatus = @status, ORDER BY SubmittedOn DESC; TOP 1000 for statuses 0/1, TOP 200 otherwise. Columns in SELECT order.

columns.name: SubmittedOn
columns.description: When submitted (original HC3 column; type inferred from GETDATE() comparisons in publicWeb_submitKennelRequest)

columns.name: ConfirmedAt
columns.description: When the requester confirmed their email

columns.name: FirstName
columns.description: Original HC3 column; width not in repo

columns.name: LastName
columns.description: Original HC3 column; width not in repo

columns.name: HashName
columns.description: Original HC3 column; width not in repo

columns.name: KennelFacebookUrl
columns.description: Original HC3 column (a social link now; the Facebook integration is defunct)

columns.name: HashCash
columns.description: Members' run fee as typed (submit caps at 50)

columns.name: ReviewNote
columns.description: Reviewer note; auto-close appends to it

columns.name: RequestSource
columns.description: 'website' when made by New kennel from a website; NULL for the public form

columns.name: ExistingHasherId
columns.description: A live (Removed = 0) HC.Hasher with the same Email (TOP 1, unordered)

columns.name: SimilarKennels
columns.description: Up to five 'Name (slug)' labels joined by ' · '; NULL for closed statuses or no match

rowsets.name: StatusCounts
rowsets.description: On success: one row per RequestStatus present in the table (all rows, including removed ones), ordered by status.

sideEffects: UPDATE EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport: open requests (RequestStatus 0/1) whose KennelId is a live HC.Kennel are set RequestStatus 2, removed 1, ConfirmCode NULL, ReviewedAt SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(), ReviewNote appended 'Closed automatically: the kennel already exists (<name>).', updatedAt GETDATE()

codeSmells.detail: Lines 69-79: opening the queue runs an UPDATE (auto-close of already-created kennels) outside any explicit transaction. Deliberate (2026-10-11) and idempotent, but a 'get' that mutates is surprising and runs on every page load.
Lines 137-141: TOP 1 with no ORDER BY when several live accounts share an email; which one is reported is arbitrary.

codeSmells.issue: Mixed timestamp types on one row
codeSmells.detail: Line 76 stamps updatedAt with GETDATE() (server local) while ReviewedAt gets SYSDATETIMEOFFSET().

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
